selection_rule: per-experiment highest validation wins, no truncations, earliest checkpoint on ties; old baselines preserved regardless. Primary full-roster learned candidate highest validation selected warm seed. No promotion without independent scope-supported advantage.

disjoint.coverage_scope: Coordinator fixtures actually reset, self/opponent six-slot rosters and selected three sets; includes active incomplete episodes. Not public actor/critic input, nor executed-move frequency.

full_domain_identity.partition_scope: All 231 base species eligible in each split; unordered complete teams and joint species/moveset combinations disjoint across train/validation/test/rare-form assessment; deterministic independent generation seeds. Individual upstream sets may recur (overlap measured), preserving the native generator distribution. No species- or individual-set-unseen claim.

roster.coverage_scope: Coordinator fixtures actually reset, self/opponent six-slot rosters and selected three sets; includes active incomplete episodes. Not public actor/critic input, nor executed-move frequency.
